claim: The source-hash regression assumed Git existed in every CI runtime.
evidence: Rocky 8 test container lacked git and errored.
The test now skips only when git is absent and executes normally when present.
impact: A portability-only test could block all five CI jobs.
required_action: Make the source-hash probe conditional on Git availability and rerun the matrix.

prevention.action: The Git-dependent test uses an explicit environment skip; supported hosts still execute it.
prevention.fallback_reason: Rocky 8 python38 image does not include Git by default.
